PURPOSE: Every MK1 artifact needs an explicit task outcome.
OUTPUT_CONTRACT: Every MK1 artifact needs observable output semantics.
CONTEXT: The task depends on supplied variables, constraints or non-trivial operating context.
INTAKE: Interaction permits targeted questions for missing required inputs.
ASSUMPTIONS: The task needs explicit handling of inference, ambiguity or consequential uncertainty.
CONSTRAINTS: The brief contains truth, evidence, safety or task-specific invariants.
QUALITY_GATE: The result benefits from an explicit final contract/self-check before return.
FALLBACK: The task needs defined behavior when information or evidence is insufficient.

policy: Select the smallest purposeful architecture. Section count is not a quality metric.
